title: 会社員(中高年の男性)の仕事の場面
subject_en: Scenes of a middle-aged Japanese male office worker in his forties to fifties (short hair, a little grey, suit and tie or shirt sleeves, glasses on some), the same man in every scene, each ONE small complete scene centred in its cell, flat style, simple round face with dot eyes and a mild expression. Include no company names. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (paper, shirts, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 会議・出張・残業・通勤など、中高年の会社員男性の日常を、フラットなタッチで描いた12点です。社内文書やビジネス記事に使えます。

the man seated at a meeting table reading printed documents
the man standing beside a blank screen, pointing at it with a pen
